decision: Both synthetic image-side descriptions were correct. Prior handshake choices cannot be attributed to a universal image-delivery failure in this matched ER2 pipeline. No prompt/source changes promoted.
scope: Actual Google ER2 Live TEXT plus Puck TTS using reviewed production service and isolated fake HTTP tools; identical synthetic JPEGs/typed requests. No ASR, browser, personal media, speaker playback or robot.

source.probe_only_config: maxOutputTokens2048; no extra instructions, no side hints. Each session used baseline prompt and selected fake tools. Model tool calls would have been refused; none occurred.

cases.request: Describe where the person is in this image; do not call tools.
cases.description: The illustrated person is standing on the left side of the image on a grey surface against a plain, light-colored background.
tts_texts: The illustrated person is standing on the left side of the image on a grey surface against a plain, light-colored background.

cases.request: Describe where the person is in this image; do not call tools.
cases.description: The person is standing on the right side of the image, wearing a blue long-sleeved shirt and dark blue pants.
tts_texts: The person is standing on the right side of the image, wearing a blue long-sleeved shirt and dark blue pants.

cost.method: Live observed prompt/tooluse and response/thought counters; TTS maximum cumulative counters per request, not sum per chunk.
cost.limitations: Observed usage estimate, not invoice/enforced cap. Live responseTokenCount is missing for both cases; no invented output count. Raw usage preserved. Only these two requests; no retries.

interpretation: The same synthetic JPEG/three-send realtime-video path produced semantically correct image-side descriptions in two fresh sessions. IMAGE tokens were accounted for, but provider does not acknowledge ingestion of each sent frame.

This narrows the prior all-right handshake result toward request-dependent decision/side-to-tool mapping; it does not identify a unique cause, establish image understanding on every turn, or show reliable social hand selection.
Synthetic fixtures bypass camera capture/lens processing; no physical camera mounting or robot/body-side proof. No real microphone, browser, audible speaker playback or hardware.
Same source/prompt/images as ER handshake study, different task text. Prior poor handshake cases remain preserved; no prompting candidate promoted.

shutdown.probe: Exec exit0 observed when polled after final result; no lingering task-owned process.
shutdown.hardware: No hardware, SSH, motors or user media accessed.

interpretation_qualification.scope: The class probes paw on the caller side; baseline generic handshakes did not explicitly require nearest paw. Correct descriptions here isolate the desired capability gap toward task-dependent choice, not prove baseline instruction violation. No-view clarification is an optional design policy.
